'''Camrov''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] who joined the [[Order of Revan]] along with [[Mochiri]] and [[Orton]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1stm}}
